moments.description: A black screen is displayed before the web application loads.
The TodoMVC JavaScript ES6 application is open showing an empty todo input with placeholder text "What needs to be done?".
"Buy milk" is added to the list with "1 item left" shown in the footer and the "All" filter active.
"Finish the hackathon demo video" is added to the list, showing "2 items left" under the "All" filter.
"Call mom" is added to the list, showing "3 items left" under the "All" filter.
"fix login bug" is added to the list, displaying "4 items left" in the footer under the "All" filter.
The list displays four active todos with the counter reading "4 items left" and the cursor hovering idly across the page.
"fix login bug" is checked off, displaying a checkmark and strikethrough, with "3 items left" and a "Clear completed" button visible.
"Finish the hackathon demo video" is checked off, leaving "2 items left" indicated in the footer.
The "Active" filter is selected, displaying active tasks "Call mom" and "Buy milk", with "2 items left" in the footer.
The "Completed" filter is selected, showing checked tasks "fix login bug" and "Finish the hackathon demo video" with "2 items left" in the footer.
The "All" filter is selected, showing all four items with "2 items left" and the "Clear completed" button.
The list remains on the "All" filter view with four items listed and the cursor hovering over the "Completed" button.
